filter_drops_similarity_range.name: filter_drops_similarity_range
filter_drops_similarity_range.value: similarity IS NULL OR similarity BETWEEN -1 AND 1

model_calls_classification_versioned.name: model_calls_classification_versioned
model_calls_classification_versioned.value: purpose <> 'classification' OR monitor_version IS NOT NULL

poll_runs_stop_reason_known.name: poll_runs_stop_reason_known
poll_runs_stop_reason_known.value: stop_reason IS NULL OR stop_reason IN ('budget_exhausted', 'no_credentials', 'no_provider_choice', 'not_offered', 'resume_key_missing', 'collection_abandoned', 'provider_wait', 'page_cap', 'still_collecting', 'error')

posts_provider_known.name: posts_provider_known
posts_provider_known.value: provider IS NULL OR provider IN ('brightdata', 'scrapecreators', 'socialcrawl', 'apify', 'socialdata')

posts_replies_stopped_known.name: posts_replies_stopped_known
posts_replies_stopped_known.value: replies_stopped IS NULL OR replies_stopped IN ('threshold', 'ceiling', 'budget', 'end')

posts_reply_has_parent.name: posts_reply_has_parent
posts_reply_has_parent.value: (kind = 'post' AND parent_post_id IS NULL) OR (kind = 'reply' AND parent_post_id IS NOT NULL)

query_estimate_probes_provider_known.name: query_estimate_probes_provider_known
query_estimate_probes_provider_known.value: provider IS NULL OR provider IN ('brightdata', 'scrapecreators', 'socialcrawl', 'apify', 'socialdata')
